data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-s', meaning 'to soften', 'to make gentle'. The name Mahnush signifies a tender, gentle, and kind-hearted individual. The name Mahnush carries the meaning “Gentle, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahnush usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
